title: Agno MVP: Boot + Transcript Context Ingestion

questions.prompt: Which model provider API key do you have ready right now?
questions.description: The platform needs at least one LLM key to boot. OpenAI is also needed for default Knowledge embeddings (text-embedding-3-small). You can run NVIDIA NIM as the chat model and OpenAI just for embeddings, or use a single provider for both.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Anthropic (claude-sonnet-4-6) for chat + OpenAI key for embeddings

options.label: OpenAI key just for embeddings (pair with another chat provider)

questions.prompt: Which transcript locations should we ingest FIRST for the evidence platform context? (We can add more later.)
questions.description: I found three main locations. Pick the one(s) most likely to have your platform-building AI conversations — the chats where you designed the evidence MCP platform, discussed architecture, etc.

options.label: OneDrive/Case Bible/AI_Chats (if platform-building chats are there)

questions.prompt: Should we ingest ALL conversations found, or filter to platform/tech conversations only?
questions.description: The transcript directories contain a mix of platform-building chats AND case/legal/personal chats. Ingesting everything adds noise to the Knowledge base the agents query for coding help.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Filter: ingest only platform-building / tech conversations (skip case/legal/personal)

options.label: I'll hand-copy the relevant transcripts into knowledge/platform/conversations/ myself

questions.prompt: Should n8n + Cloudflare R2 be wired into the compose.yaml as part of this goal?
questions.description: Both are confirmed in scope for the platform (ADR-0007), but they're not needed to boot or ingest transcripts. Adding them now is low risk but adds scope.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Defer — add n8n + R2 to compose in a follow-on goal

options.label: Defer — not needed for boot + ingest goal (recommended)
Include now — wire n8n + R2 into compose.yaml while we're at it

questions.prompt: What does 'done' look like for this goal?
questions.description: Pick the acceptance test that tells you the goal is achieved.
questions.recommendedAnswer: The platform boots + an agent answers a grounded architecture question from the ingested transcripts

options.label: Agent answers a question about the evidence platform architecture, citing the imported transcripts (recommended)
Platform boots, /docs is reachable, router dispatches correctly — no ingestion required
All transcript sources indexed + agent can discuss any platform decision from them

questions.prompt: Should the TS/Py MCP servers (from dev-resources MCP_PLATFORM) be vendored and wired as part of this goal?
questions.description: The MCP servers are the source of real tools (hash, parse, normalize, etc.). Without them agents only have Context Providers and Knowledge — which IS enough for context ingestion. Vendoring them is Phase 7 in the build plan.
questions.recommendedAnswer: Defer — not needed for boot + ingest; add in next goal

options.label: Defer — not needed for context ingestion goal (recommended)
Include — vendor mcp-servers/ and wire MCPTools in app/main.py
